meta_description: Book The Maine Squeeze | Golf Cart | Newly Renovated directly on LocalVR for the best rates. No third-party fees. Welcome to our beautifully renovated vacation home in Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, perfectly located on 30A between Alys & Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill & S...
description_expanded: SummaryWelcome to our beautifully renovated vacation home in Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, perfectly located on 30A between Alys & Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill & Seaside. This stylish getaway features a spacious screened-in porch, a well-appointed kitchen, and a modern coastal design curated by a professional Nashville design team. Enjoy access to a large resort-style pool, deeded beach access, a 6-seater golf cart, and four adult bikes—everything you need for an unforgettable beachside escape!SpaceWelcome to your coastal sanctuary at Magnolia Cottages by the Sea! This high-end designer retreat has been recently renovated throughout, blending modern sophistication with the relaxed charm of seaside living. Nestled in a prime location, between Alys & Rosemary Beach to the East and The Big Chill & Seaside to the West, this property offers the perfect fusion of warmth, style, and comfort. As you step through the front door, you are greeted by an inviting open concept living space. The interior has been professionally decorated by a popular Nashville design team, and showcases a hip and trendy modern space that effortlessly captures the essence of beachside chic. Earth tones dominate the color palette, creating a warm and calming ambiance throughout the home. The living room is a haven of comfort, featuring plush high-end furnishings and contemporary décor that invite you to unwind after a day of beach activities. Large windows frame the spacious screened in porch, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. The kitchen is a chef’s delight, boasting stainless steel appliances, sleek countertops and, high-end cookware rarely seen in a rental property. In addition, you will enjoy a large assortment of herbs, spices, and cooking oils, all complimentary for your use. Whether you’re preparing a casual beachside picnic or a gourmet feast, this kitchen is equipped to meet all your culinary needs. The bedrooms are thoughtfully designed with a modern aesthetic and furnished for optimal relaxation. Each bedroom enjoys its own streaming TV and ensuite bathroom to further indulge in the luxury of your private retreat. Step outside to the expansive screened - in porch, where you can enjoy coffee or cocktails, alfresco dining, or simply savor the ocean breeze. Steps from the screened in porch is the resort style, zero entry swimming pool that is enjoyed by many of our guests in the Magnolia community. As if this wasn’t enough, this showcase property offers a 6-seater street legal golf cart and 4 adult bikes so you can explore our beautiful paradise any way you please. The Maine Squeeze not only offers a stylish retreat with a decided island feel, but also a lifestyle centered around an easy-going coastal vibe. This home is a rare gem which seamlessly combines modern living with the timeless allure of the sea. Don’t miss the opportunity to make this coastal haven your vacation home! HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Steps from resort style pool (heated depending on ambient nightly temperatures) - Community green space (near the pool) for kids and pets to play BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by a local vendor; information provided upon request after booking TRANSPORTATION - Bikes are a popular way to explore! 4 are included with this property. - A 6 seater Golf Cart is included complimentary with this property. Please note - operators of the golf cart must be 25 years of age with a valid drivers license. Signed waiver and proof of insurance required. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8) - Primary Suite, First Floor - King bed, private bathroom with walk-in shower - King Bedroom 2, Second Floor - King bed, private bathroom with walk in shower - Bunk Room, Second Floor - 2 twin bunk beds, private bathroom with shower/tub combo FEATURES -30A – 3 Bedroom / 3.5 Bathroom House - Professionally decorated - new furnishings - Sleeps 8 (King, King, 2 Twin/Twin bunks) - Golf Cart - 4 Adult bikes - Huge Screened Porch - Large Open Floor Plan - Well Appointed Kitchen - Full Size Refrigerator - Full Size Stove/Oven - Ice Maker - Full Size Washer & Dryer - TV in Living Room & Bedrooms - Complimentary Wi-Fi - Use of Owners 6 Beach Chairs and 4 Beach Towels - Outdoor Shower - Parking for 2 cars in driveway and 1 along street - Large Resort Style Community Pool - Easy walk or golf cart ride to the beach; neighborhood is immediately across 30A from the beach access - 18 Mile Bike Path Along 30ANotesA Note on Shared Amenities: Please keep in mind that these spaces are operated by the HOA. Because of this, they are subject to seasonal availability—common seasonal closures may include April-May and Sept-Nov—and we can't be held responsible for unexpected closures or repairs. If you are booking specifically for a shared amenity, please feel free to reach out with any questions in advance!House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 19. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 20. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. 21. Bicycles must yield to pedestrians when riding on sidewalks. Use designated crosswalks and follow all traffic laws. 22. Helmets are required for riders under 16. Nighttime riding requires a front light and rear reflectors for visibility. 23. Only licensed and insured drivers may operate golf carts and low-speed vehicles (LSVs). 24. Golf carts and LSVs must follow Florida motor vehicle laws and may only be driven on roads with speed limits of 35 mph or less. 25. Golf carts and LSVs may not be driven on sidewalks or bike paths. Working headlights and taillights are required for nighttime use. 26. Bicycles must be locked when parked and marked with identification for return. Guests are responsible for any loss, theft, or damage during the rental. 27. Golf cart and LSV drivers must ensure all passengers wear seatbelts and do not exceed passenger limits. 28. Reckless driving or unauthorized modifications to golf carts and LSVs is prohibited. Park responsibly and return vehicles clean and fully charged or refueled. 29. LSVs and bicycles are not allowed within the Rosemary Beach Community. 30. Guests are responsible for any fines, tickets, or damages incurred during use. Bicycles and golf carts/LSVs must be returned in the same condition as provided. 31. Guests acknowledge the inherent risks of using bicycles and operating golf carts/LSVs. 32. Guests agree to indemnify and hold harmless LocalVR, its owners, and employees from any claims or damages arising from use. 33. LocalVR and the property owner are not liable for injuries or damages incurred, except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct. Read Less
